title: Invisible Snails
description: You hate the Life Series snails? Just get rid of them
body:
**A resource pack made for the [Life Series](https://modrinth.com/mod/life-series) mod**

**WARNING - This pack removes all mob shadows in order to make the snails truely invisible**

This resource pack changes the following snails to be invisible:
- Snail
- Zombie Snail
- VHSnail

Snail skins override this removal so make sure you have any set

To use it just put the pack above the Life Series default resourcepack and enjoy a snail free Life Series experience. 

## Recommendations for server side

Place a repeating command blocking running: 

```
/effect give @e[type=lifeseries:snail] minecraft:invisibility infinite 1 true
```
Then run this to hide the command messages:

```
/gamerule command_block_output false
```
This makes sure players can't use hitboxes to find the snail.
